rules.question: What does the comparison call a status on a tile, in the Status dropdown, in its hover or in the counts phrase?
rules.owner: kStatusWords in src/app/dm_report.h, read through status_words
rules.pattern: "(Under optimal|At optimal|Above optimal|No current result|No paths|Not in your library|not in your library|Not in library|Other speed|with no paths|at another speed|at other speeds)( \([^)]*\))?"
must_match: out += ", " + hydra::counted(stats.other_speed, "at another speed", "at other speeds");
must_not_match: inline constexpr const char* kNoPathsFound = "No paths found.";
rules.note: The comparison's status words, apart from the table cell (the kStatus* word, app.json's row), live once in kStatusWords. A tile, dropdown, hover or counts word typed elsewhere is a second spelling that can drift from the table. Decided by: D114 items 1 and 2, concept audit M01 and M02.

rules.question: What does a report say when nothing matches its filters, and what does its chart search box hint?
rules.pattern: Nothing matches those filters|Search song, artist, or charter
must_match: if (report_frame::search_box(w.memory, "Search song, artist, or charter")) apply_filters(w);
must_not_match: if (report_frame::search_box(w.memory, "Search song, artist, charter, or path notation"))
rules.note: The report windows and the fill page share these two phrases; the page is built from hydra_core, so the home is html_page.h, not GUI code. A third copy typed elsewhere would drift. Decided by: D114 item 22, concept audit M07.
